verdict.rationale: Cake documents a first-party, read-only MCP integration that lets Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client query the live cap table (shareholders, option pool, share classes, SAFEs, notes), so an agent can pull current cap table data programmatically. Nothing documents a data room or reconciliation workflow, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so any reconciliation would have to be built on the agent side. Missing for 10: documented data room integration or reconciliation capability, a full structured cap table export via API or MCP, detailed MCP tool and schema documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent pull my current cap table programmatically and reconcile it against my data room before a financing

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client to Cake and ask about your Cap Table in plain English.
Ask your AI assistant about shareholders, option pool headroom, vesting, share classes, SAFEs and notes - answered from your live Cap Table in Cake. All read-only.
